turns.utterance: Starting encoder diagnostic procedure.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please complete the following checks: First, inspect the encoder scale for scratches, oil, or coolant deposits. Second, check the read head mounting for looseness or impact damage. Third, inspect the cable and connector for chafing or corrosion.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the encoder scale for scratches, oil, or coolant deposits. 2. Check the read head mounting for looseness or impact damage. 3. Inspect the cable and connector for chafing or corrosion.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I'm seeing some condensation buildup inside the encoder housing itself, like moisture has been getting in there. The procedure doesn't say anything about checking for water intrusion or seal integrity.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Visual inspection complete. The encoder scale is clean with no scratches, the read head is securely mounted with no visible damage, and the cable and connector show no signs of chafing or corrosion.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the encoder scale for scratches, oil, or coolant deposits. 2. Check the read head mounting for looseness or impact damage. 3. Inspect the cable and connector for chafing or corrosion.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is there physical damage to the encoder strip or read head?

ground_truth.node_text: Physical damage to encoder strip or read head?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, both the encoder strip and read head appear to be in good physical condition.

ground_truth.node_text: Physical damage to encoder strip or read head?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the signal quality clean with a good waveform and no dropouts?

ground_truth.node_text: Signal quality: clean waveform, no dropouts?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, both A and B channels are producing clean square waves with proper ninety degree phase separation and no missing pulses.

ground_truth.node_text: Signal quality: clean waveform, no dropouts?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Was the reference mark found during the homing cycle?

ground_truth.node_text: Reference mark found during homing cycle?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the axis decelerated smoothly on the home switch trigger and came to rest at the reference mark position. The displayed home offset matches the stored parameter value.

ground_truth.node_text: Reference mark found during homing cycle?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the position accuracy within tolerance at all test points?

ground_truth.node_text: Position accuracy within tolerance at all test points?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, I've recorded the encoder feedback and commanded positions at all ten reference points. The maximum positioning error is well within the axis accuracy specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Position accuracy within tolerance at all test points?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the thermal compensation parameter active and correct?

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal compensation parameter active and correct?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the thermal compensation coefficient matches the reference value for this machine and the compensation model has not been modified since the last calibration.

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal compensation parameter active and correct?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the cable condition and routing acceptable?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the cable routing is good with no sharp bends, no contact with rotating parts, and all strain relief clamps are tight and properly positioned. I flexed the cable at several points and saw no signal glitches.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Did the final five point position verification cycle pass?

ground_truth.node_text: Final 5 point position verification cycle passed?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the verification cycle shows positioning errors that exceed tolerance at two of the five test points.

ground_truth.node_text: Final 5 point position verification cycle passed?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. Escalation required: encoder calibration by metrology is necessary. Please notify the metrology team and place this machine on production hold pending calibration.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: encoder calibration by metrology required

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, I'll contact metrology and update the machine status now.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: encoder calibration by metrology required
